subject.title: [AI-assisted] Preserve thread sessions across daily reset by default

question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessionClosedAt` as the durable core-owned session-entry marker and reserved plugin-slot key for closed transport thread rollover?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but the new persisted key becomes an upgrade and plugin-slot compatibility contract that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Accept durable marker
options.body: Approve `sessionClosedAt` as the core-owned closed-thread lifecycle state and allow the PR to proceed once exact-head gates are green.

options.title: Keep state narrower
options.body: Ask for a redesign that keeps closed-thread state behind a Discord/plugin-owned or otherwise narrower compatibility seam.

options.title: Pause for session-state design
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader session-state and storage migration direction decides the permanent shape.

recommendation.title: Accept durable marker
recommendation.body: Approve `sessionClosedAt` as the core-owned closed-thread lifecycle state and allow the PR to proceed once exact-head gates are green.

likelyOwner.reason: The session-entry and plugin-slot contract decision aligns best with Peter Steinberger's recent ownership of these central session/runtime surfaces.
